behavior_constraints: retry and retries are mutually exclusive on a step (exit 4)
retry must be a mapping; unknown keys inside are a validation error (exit 4)
retry.count is required when retry: is declared (exit 4)
retry.count, retry.initial_ms, retry.max_ms must be integers >= 0 (exit 4)
retry.backoff must be one of fixed|linear|exponential (exit 4)
fixed delay = initial_ms; linear delay = initial_ms*n; exponential delay = initial_ms*2^(n-1)
delay clamped to [0, max_ms] when max_ms>0; no upper bound when max_ms==0
jitter subtracts a pseudo-random integer in [0, delay/4] from delay, never below 0, never exceeding max_ms clamp
scalar retries: form still uses fixed backoff with initial_ms=100 matching R1 exactly
affected_prior: R1 retries: scalar form must coexist with structured retry: and remain fixed/initial_ms=100
R1/R2 report.json schema: new retry_attempts field on every step entry, conditionally_skipped status with its neutral field set
R1/R2 events.ndjson: new step_conditionally_skipped event; retry_delay_ms field on retry step_started events
R1/R2 DAG scheduler: must evaluate when before launch, treat conditionally-skipped dependents as eligible, exclude skipped steps from order_attempted
R2 content-addressed cache: conditionally-skipped steps bypass cache entirely (no lookup, no write, no cache_key file)
R2 resource reservations: conditionally-skipped steps must not reserve resources
entities.summary: Round 3 adds structured retry policies with backoff/jitter, conditional `when:` steps with a conditionally_skipped status, workflow-level hooks, plus (named but underspecified in the visible text) foreach expansion, structured outputs, and resume; new report/event fields are added while all R1/R2 behavior must remain non-regressive.

Extend the `flowr` orchestrator with six new feature families and a targeted clarification of an existing rule. All behavior specified in rounds 1 and 2 continues to hold without regression:

* matrix expansion rules,
* `${VAR}` interpolation,
